title: Frutiger Aero 2007 telecom
reason: Frutiger Aero suits a telecom sign-up and the progress bar touches the real OTP, plan and SIM steps, but the gloss lives only on one button and a bubble bar, so it decorates the flow rather than changing how it reads.

title: Ruler Ticks estate listing
reason: Ruler tick coordinates and price pins act on the listing's real map and tie to measuring space in real estate, so it passes all three checks; the off-luxury yellow wood and the sabkha crust that never shows are coherence problems, not relevance.
